prompt: Manage Salesforce opportunity pipeline data: list open opportunities, update opportunity stages and required fields, verify record changes, consolidate duplicate contact data, and create a follow-up task linked to CRM records.

results.use_case: Manage Salesforce opportunity pipeline data: list open opportunities, update opportunity stages and required fields, verify record changes, consolidate duplicate contact data, and create a follow-up task linked to CRM records.
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite (if opportunity_id unknown)]: Locate the Opportunity using SALESFORCE_SEARCH_OPPORTUNITIES or SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (tight filters; return Id plus minimal identifying fields).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the target record using SALESFORCE_GET_OPPORTUNITY (ensure it’s the intended record; capture RecordTypeId for stage/picklist context).

[Optional (if field API names/required fields are uncertain)] [Prerequisite]: Validate Stage field + any required reason/close fields using SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT (note which updates must go via custom_fields).
[Required] [Step]: Update only intended fields using SALESFORCE_UPDATE_OPPORTUNITY (set StageName/stage_name; include needed custom_fields; treat any non-empty response.data.errors as failure).

[Optional (for confirmation or bulk checks)] [Next Step]: Verify persistence using SALESFORCE_GET_OPPORTUNITY or SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (re-read and compare; chunk Id lists if queries get too large).

[Optional (if update rejected by sales process/validation/picklists)] [Fallback]: Fetch allowed stage values using SALESFORCE_GET_PICKLIST_VALUES_BY_RECORD_TYPE (RecordTypeId) and retry SALESFORCE_UPDATE_OPPORTUNITY; if still blocked, retry failed Ids with SALESFORCE_SOBJECT_ROWS_UPDATE to surface validation errors and required fields.
known_pitfalls: [SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Only supports SELECT; non-SELECT queries fail (must start with "SELECT").
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Connector input key can differ (e.g., expects query vs soql_query); otherwise errors like missing required field.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] MALFORMED_QUERY (e.g., “Disjunctions not supported”) or INVALID_FIELD can occur with complex filters/relationship dereference; simplify queries and filter client-side.

[SALESFORCE_UPDATE_OPPORTUNITY] StageName/stage_name must match the sales process for the record’s RecordTypeId; common 400s include INVALID_OR_NULL_FOR_RESTRICTED_PICKLIST and FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION.
[SALESFORCE_UPDATE_OPPORTUNITY] Some updates return empty bodies or include INVALID_FIELD inside response.data.errors; don’t assume success unless errors are empty and read-back matches.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Filter an Opportunity describe payload down to loss-related fields (names/labels/types/picklist values) for faster troubleshooting
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
fields=describe_payload.get('fields',[])
keys=('loss','closed lost')
out=[]
for f in fields:
    n=(f.get('name') or '').lower(); l=(f.get('label') or '').lower()
    if any(k in n or k in l for k in keys):
        out.append({'name':f.get('name'),'label':f.get('label'),'type':f.get('type'),'updateable':f.get('updateable'),'picklist_values':[pv.get('value') for pv in (f.get('picklistValues') or []) if pv.get('active')]})
out
```

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Filter an object describe payload to find likely field API names by keyword (useful when the full describe is large).
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
fields=describe_payload.get('fields',[])
keys=('source','channel','detail')
out=[{'name':f.get('name'),'label':f.get('label'),'type':f.get('type')} for f in fields if any(k in (f.get('name') or '').lower() or k in (f.get('label') or '').lower() for k in keys)]
out
```

SALESFORCE_UPDATE_OPPORTUNITY.description: Updates an existing opportunity in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated. Returns HTTP 204 with empty body on success; call SALESFORCE_GET_OPPORTUNITY afterward to read updated values. Updates may fail with FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION or REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING — inspect the error message to identify the offending field.

name.description: Updated opportunity name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

type.description: Updated opportunity type. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

amount.description: Updated amount. Leave unset to keep unchanged. Negative values are passed through to Salesforce as-is.

next_step.description: Updated next step. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

account_id.description: Updated Account ID. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

close_date.description: Updated close date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

stage_name.description: Updated stage. Leave empty to keep unchanged. Must exactly match a stage defined in the org's current sales process; use SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT with object_name='Opportunity' to discover valid values.

examples: Deal expanded to include additional services
description.description: Updated description. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

lead_source.description: Updated lead source. Leave empty to keep unchanged.

probability.description: Updated probability percentage (0-100). Leave unset to keep unchanged.

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values to update. Use the exact API name ending with '__c'. IMPORTANT for lookup/reference fields: Fields that reference other records (e.g., Contact__c, User__c, Account__c) require a valid 18-character Salesforce record ID (e.g., '003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' for Contact, '005XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX' for User), NOT descriptive names or text. Passing names like 'John Smith' instead of IDs will fail with MALFORMED_ID error. IMPORTANT for picklist fields: Restricted picklists only accept predefined values from the Salesforce org. Use SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT with object_name='Opportunity' to discover field types and valid values.

opportunity_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the opportunity to update. Multiple opportunities may share the same name — apply additional filters (stage, owner, account) or confirm with the user before updating to avoid modifying the wrong record. Use IDs from fresh search results; stale or manually constructed IDs may be invalid.

SALESFORCE_SOBJECT_ROWS_UPDATE.description: Tool to update specific fields in an existing Salesforce sObject record. Use when you need to modify one or more fields in a record without affecting other fields.

fields.description: Dictionary of field name/value pairs to update. Only include fields that need to be updated. Field names must match the API names of the sObject fields (e.g., 'Phone', 'Name', 'CustomField__c'). Field names are case-sensitive.

record_id.description: The unique 15 or 18-character Salesforce ID of the record to update.

sobject_api_name.description: The API name of the Salesforce object type to update (e.g., Account, Contact, Opportunity, CustomObject__c). Case-sensitive.

SALESFORCE_GET_OPPORTUNITY.description: Retrieves a specific opportunity by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

fields.description: Comma-delimited string of Opportunity field API names to retrieve. If omitted, all fields are returned. Custom objects may use non-standard API names for common fields (e.g., primary contact); verify exact field API names and handle null values.

opportunity_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the opportunity to retrieve. Must be a valid 15 or 18 character alphanumeric Salesforce ID (e.g., '006Wd000005FG3CIAW'). When multiple similarly named opportunities exist in search results, confirm the correct record by `Id` or other key attributes before passing the ID here.
